name: za-payroll-paye-uif-sdl
description: South African payroll for the 2027 tax year (1 March 2026 to 28 February 2027): employees' tax (PAYE) under the Fourth Schedule to the Income Tax Act 58 of 1962, Unemployment Insurance Fund contributions under the Unemployment Insurance Contributions Act 4 of 2002, and the Skills Development Levy under the Skills Development Levies Act 9 of 1999. Covers the 2027 tax bands, rebates, thresholds, medical scheme fees tax credits, the annual-equivalent method, the retirement fund deduction, UIF at 1% + 1% up to R17 712 a month and its exclusions, SDL at 1% with the R500 000 exemption, the EMP201 seven-day rule, directors, penalties and interest. Trigger on: South Africa PAYE, payroll South Africa, UIF contribution, UIF ceiling, SDL levy, EMP201, employees' tax, IRP5, medical tax credit, tax rebate 2027.
